about: The predicate keys of a simplified policy: rsqlPredicate at the top level, and a predicates object with mongodbPredicate. The suite's seeded fixtures send sqlPredicate, mongodbPredicate and querydslPredicate at the top level instead, and legacy stores them; no golden shows what they do. Each policy has no condition, so check/resource allows it; the filter says which keys became predicates of which dialect (a policy without any predicate is ALLOW).

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.

rsqlPredicate a==rsql, top-level sqlPredicate, mongodbPredicate and querydslPredicate, and predicates.mongodbPredicate. The filter's mongodb text says which mongodb key counts, its querydsl text whether querydslPredicate does, its sql text whether top-level sqlPredicate does.
Only the top-level keys the seeded fixtures send: sqlPredicate, mongodbPredicate and querydslPredicate. USE_FILTER_CONDITION with their texts if they count; ALLOW if none does.
Only predicates.mongodbPredicate, inside the predicates object. USE_FILTER_CONDITION with the mongodb text if it counts; ALLOW if not.
Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
